description: Drafts quote posts for ONE moment from the latest find_quote_moments search: the user's caption names the person and topic and adds value on top (value_mode: workflow, breakdown, disagreement, example, implication or opinion — omit to let the drafter pick). Free. `url` must be a moment url from the latest search. Waits for the drafts (usually under a minute). The drafts also land in the user's Content queue. Show them, help the user edit one; they quote the person's post with it and post from their own account.

space_id.description: The content space (brand) to run it on — from list_content_spaces. No space yet? setup_content_space first.

url.description: The moment's url (the person's own X post) from the latest search.

value_mode.description: What the caption adds on top of their claim.

name: draft_quote_post
title: Draft quote posts for one moment
